title: The Funny Puppy
lines: Meg has a funny little puppy.
The puppy digs by the pond.
It finds a penny in the mud.
The puppy runs to a lady on the path.
A little baby sits by the lady.
The baby is happy and claps.
The puppy drops the penny by the baby.
The lady gives it back to Meg.

questions.ask: What did the puppy dig up?
questions.listenFor: A penny, out of the mud by the pond. Stated in the story - point them back to the line.

questions.ask: Who did the puppy give the penny to?
questions.listenFor: The baby. Then the lady handed it back to Meg. Following the penny through three sets of hands is the real work here.

questions.ask: Do you think Meg should let the baby keep the penny? Tell me why.
questions.listenFor: Either answer is fine. Listen for the reason - the puppy found it, or the baby was happy with it.
